notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. 

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with Servonauts - Deluxe Edition and many other titles!

notes.title: Demo Update - Quality of Life
notes.content:
ATTENTION ALL SERVONAUTS

The playable demo has been updated with brand new quality of life features - and new stuff to smash!!

Simpler controls! We’re really excited to get these out. Playtest data shows a huge improvement.
Auto-swap: it’s now a simple matter to plug a pipe in where there’s already something attached - you’ll simply swap ‘em out.
You can now grab and throw all the stuff around in the Servonauts’ RV between levels?! (We couldn’t believe how many people asked for this feature…)
 
Alongside this update, we've given our Steam store page a fresh coat of paint, with new screenshots and a more concise and exciting description of the game. These changes are so important for an indie game pre-release, and were based on feedback from players. We'd love to hear more from you all, so please don't hesitate to jump into our Discord and tell us what you think of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398544/c09aafcc25a5c312b19e3ee4106564e46c883749.png

Now, we’d like to offer a bit of a teaser (we’ve been very busy behind the scenes). This public demo only has a subset of the full Servonauts experience - an aspect of the game we refer to internally as “managing mayhem”. We’re currently preparing to showcase the game at Gamescom Cologne 2024, where we’ll unveil a whole new set of features based around “building and logistics”. Soon you’ll be building and optimising each level’s gas station in addition to managing it.

We’ll leave you with the rest of the demo update changelog, followed by some screenshots.

Simpler controls.
Auto-swap held pipes with plugged or dropped ones.
Grabbable clutter in the RV.
Overhauled keyboard controls - we still recommend gamepad, but keyboard should at least be more intuitive than it was before.
Updates to selection logic: it should now be more consistent and closer to user intention.
Updated colours of orange and yellow fuels for improved visibility.
Additionally changed colour of empty pipes to dull grey - it just makes sense!
Brand new flow system for fuel networks.
Overhaul of scoring in Quota Mode levels.
Tweaks to the order + requests of cars across many levels.
Player death VFX.
Servonauts have a little animation for grabbing now.
New set dressing and scatter visuals in each level… we're hinting at ~THE LORE~
Updated World 2 skybox and clouds.
Quicksand replaced with tar pits!
Fixed issues with character IK and jittering.
Fixed clipping in title screen Servonaut animation.
Lots of performance optimisations.

Still here? Lucky you, we've snuck some teasers into the end of this post! Now, the changelog on our end is much longer than the list above, but the majority of it is super secret stuff for the Gamescom build. We have, however, managed to sneak just a few dot points past our bosses - remember these changes won't be in this demo, but they ARE coming down the pipeline:

Implemented Orbital Destruction Laser
New crude oil truck
Added coin collector bot

That's all we have for you for now. 'Til next time!
-Louis

notes.title: Demo Updated!!
notes.content:
ATTENTION ALL SERVONAUTS

We’ve just launched an update for the live demo!
Let’s look at some of the bigger, more exciting changes first - we’ll get to the small stuff later.


 UNLOCKABLE HATS! There’s one for every level - now you’ll really want to go for a high score.
 Character select! Many of you wanted to play as your favourite ‘Naut - now you can. And… who knows, maybe some brand new Servonauts are out there in the galaxy, waiting to join the team?
 Big changes to pipe behaviour to make gameplay smoother and more satisfying - pipes, are longer, stretchier, and no longer need to connect to each other end-to-end.
 Brand new level! We’ve pulled “V Formation” from the demo for now and replaced it with a new level called “Double Split”. This new one should better fit the difficulty progression through the demo.
 Quota mode! This new gamemode removes the time limit and challenges you to fill a set number of cars as quickly as you can. We’re calling the old gamemode “Shift mode”, and it’ll still feature in the demo.
 Big changes to the very first level to help new players ease into the game.
 Save and load system to track level unlocks, cosmetic unlocks, equipped hats.


We hope you’re as excited as us for all this new demo content. To wrap things up, we’ll leave you with some sneak peeks of stuff we’ve been working on (note that not all of this is included in the demo!) followed by the rest of this update’s patch notes:

Demo Changelog:

 Lobby rework, part of a larger suite of changes that are still in the pipeline.
 This includes the icon mats to highlight interactables.
 In addition, the level select UI is partway through an overhaul of its own. Changes to size of Servonauts and all the interactable gameplay objects.
 The mixer joint now freely spins - this helps your pipes from getting tied in knots through the magic of *physics*
 Adjustments to fuel colours:
 Yellow fuel is more distinct
 Orange fuel to be more different to base pipe colour Respawn VFX update
 Improved character indicator icons
 Employee of the day now awarded at level end! How does it work? Who can say.
 Improvements to selection logic
 Pause screen changes colour to match which player paused
 Colour of vehicles now matches the colour fuel they want
 Level select is now way quicker to navigate
 Removed need to talk to Pilot Duck to start next level - don't worry, we have plans to make him interactable again
 Improvements to various Servonaut death VFX - more updates coming here too
 Character icons updated
 Button prompts throughout lobby and intro
 Vehicles respawn when you blow them up
 Level title also specifies Quota Mode or Shift Mode
 Removed crystals from Spaceway 66 for *lore reasons*
 Changes to camera behaviour - should be smoother and keep important elements in focus
 Improvements to performance and stability
 Tweaks to levels:
 Tweaked number of pipes in each level
 Tweaked score thresholds across levels
 Moved Servonaut spawn points across levels
 Adjusted coin spawn locations
 Some levels start with pipes pre-connected
 Changes to size and position of parking spaces in some levels (can't have the fuel requests blocking gameplay!)
And here’s some hints at stuff that’s been done behind the scenes - you won’t see this in the demo:

 Lots of new levels! 
 Lots of refinement of Worlds 3 & 4
 Unlock + progression system for level progression (disabled for the demo)
 New buttons in World 3
 Progress towards localisation
